description: L3 trusted historical movement ground-truth benchmark. Corpus-grounded evidence IDs with statement-level movement, subject, and episode validation.

queries.query: Trace Julius Caesar's route from Italy across the Adriatic into Epirus and through the campaign leading to Pharsalus in 48 BCE.
queries.subject: Julius Caesar
queries.episode: 48 BCE civil war: Italy / Brundisium → Adriatic / Ionian → Epirus → Pharsalus campaign
queries.notes: Primary L3 Roman Republic anchor for Adriatic crossing episode.

queries.query: Trace Pompey's movements after the defeat at Pharsalus, from Greece through the eastern Mediterranean until his arrival in Egypt in 48 BCE.
queries.subject: Pompey
queries.episode: Post-Pharsalus 48 BCE flight through eastern Mediterranean to Egypt
queries.notes: Pompey-life provenance; Pelusium reference is bounded-context MEDIUM.

queries.query: Reconstruct the major movements of Mithridates VI during the First Mithridatic War, from Pontus through Asia Minor and Greece, and back toward Anatolia.
queries.subject: Mithridates VI
queries.episode: First Mithridatic War: Pontus / Asia Minor / Greece
queries.notes: Appian + Livy agent-of-king references; no single perfect O+D pair in corpus.

queries.query: Trace Lucullus's campaign movements against Mithridates from Pontus through Armenia and into Asia Minor.
queries.subject: Lucullus
queries.episode: Lucullus vs Mithridates / Tigranes in Pontus and Armenia
queries.notes: Replaces Xenophon in hard L3 set: corpus lacks Anabasis primary movement references.

queries.query: Reconstruct Alexander the Great's route from Bactria through the Hindu Kush into the Indian campaign, ending near the Hydaspes.
queries.subject: Alexander the Great
queries.notes: Out-of-domain stress control; Hydaspes provenance is strong, Bactria→India arc is partial.

queries.query: Trace the route of Xenophon and the Ten Thousand from Cunaxa back to the Greek world after the Battle of Cunaxa in 401 BCE.
queries.subject: Xenophon / Ten Thousand
queries.notes: NO_TRUSTED_REFERENCE_AVAILABLE — corpus has no Anabasis primary-source movement O+D; excluded from hard recall denominator.
